verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs claim first-party infrastructure visibility into hosts, containers, cloud providers and network. They also document vendor-maintained AWS Lambda monitoring that combines CloudWatch data with code-level instrumentation, and Terraform-based management of agent fleets. Kubernetes collection is only implied, by mentions of Kubernetes cost visibility and a community remark that the in-cluster collection services exist but are fragile. That remark reflects reliability concerns, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a Kubernetes integration or agent, detail on the breadth of cloud-service integrations beyond Lambda, and independent hands-on corroboration of host and container agent setup.
